message.content: Halo! Untuk memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran XS, saya perlu memastikan Anda sudah masuk ke akun Anda. Apakah Anda bersedia memberikan nama pengguna dan kata sandi Anda (atau mengisi formulir login)? Jika Anda tidak ingin berbagi informasi sensitif di sini, Anda dapat masuk melalui situs web kami terlebih dahulu, lalu beri tahu saya bahwa Anda sudah masuk. Terima kasih!
message.reasoning: The user says in Indonesian: "Hallo, ukuran XS tidak ada ya?" Means: "Hello, is there no size XS?" They likely want to check availability of size XS. We need to authenticate? The user didn't provide credentials. We might need to ask for login. But maybe we can respond: "Apakah Anda ingin memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran XS?" We can ask for login or proceed. The tool is for authentication. We can ask user to login. Probably we should ask for username and password.
